Generate SAS tests with OpenRouter

Source: R/generate.R
generate_sas_tests_openrouter.Rd

Calls ellmer::chat_openrouter() synchronously. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .Renviron and restart R before use. The current model default is the literal string gpt-4o-mini; confirm provider support before calling.

Usage

generate_sas_tests_openrouter(
  frd,
  macro,
  model = "gpt-4o-mini",
  temperature = 0,
  max_tokens = 4096
)

Arguments

frd

An object returned by read_frd().

macro

An object returned by import_sas_macro().

model

A non-empty OpenRouter model identifier.

temperature

Sampling temperature passed to ellmer.

max_tokens

Maximum number of output tokens.

Value

A list with model, prompt, raw response text in response, and JSON decoded with simplifyVector = FALSE in parsed. Invalid JSON produces parsed = NULL; decoded output is not checked against the requested schema.

Details

The request sends the complete FRD text and SAS source to OpenRouter and its selected provider and may incur charges. Only use permitted content. Provider errors propagate. The requested JSON contains test_cases, sample_data, sas_code, sas_test_code, and traceability. Generated content requires review; SAS execution and coverage verification are not performed. This function has no application-level retries or cancellation.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
frd <- read_frd("examples/simple_frd.txt")
macro <- import_sas_macro("examples/simple_visit_flag.sas")
live_result <- generate_sas_tests_openrouter(frd, macro)
live_result$parsed
} # }
